t: Time 3093Y white flexible cable delivers heavy-duty performance for electric hobs and storage heater circuits. This 10m coil features a premium 3-core design with brown, blue and green/yellow copper conductors rated 300/500V. The substantial 2.5mm² conductor area safely handles the high current demands of major appliances, whilst the heat-resistant PVC sheath maintains integrity between -15°C and 90°C. Forty-five strands per core provide superior flexibility for complex installations and tight routing in demanding kitchen and utility environments.
b: Suitable for Electric Hobs & Storage Heaters
